glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 隹 (“short-tailed bird”) + 又 (“hand”). To hold one bird is 隻; to hold two birds is 雙.
s_page_origin: Pictogram (象形): airflow coming out of a mouth (口) – a modal particle. Compare 四 and 曰.
note: Composite id: 只 also writes other words; this sign is the 隻 sense. glyph_origin is from the 隻 page; s_page_origin is the 只 page's own text.
